storyline.real: Senna leads from pole with a failing gearbox, holds off Patrese and wins his home race for the first time, by 2.9 seconds

mastery.label: Spare the gearbox: push for no more than 34 laps

eras.briefing: Interlagos, 1991. Senna has never won at home. He started from pole, but the McLaren's gearbox is losing gears, and Patrese's Williams is closing. Pit board only: hold him in front. Reconstructed race: no lap timing survives, so the laps are rebuilt to fit the result, the fastest laps, the sourced stops and who led each lap (Jolpica, F1DB, Motor Sport, Wikipedia). Who led each lap is sourced, and so is the order at a few laps; the lap times, and the rest of the order, are reconstructed.
